The '''''Dorsal Killer''''' was a modified [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was used as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. After the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sonnos]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Deggar Feps]], Feps attempted to flee to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] aboard the [[Dartiss-5 Caravel]] ''[[Lost Lady]]''. However, the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[NEK-01]] tracked Feps to the ship and one of the droid's minions, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[NEK-072]], activated a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] calling for all nearby bounty hunters to attack the ''Lost Lady''. The ''Dorsal Killer'' received the message and attacked the ''Lost Lady'' in the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]].
